page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.12xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically driven by AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a baseline frequency of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It operates without any integrated graphics processing units. For network connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps, supporting stable data transfer rates for distributed environments.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.g9ae.12xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, mid-sized databases, and containerized microservices. The dedicated AMD EPYC hardware profile offers a resource-dense configuration that balances compute capacity and memory allocation without the overhead of specialized hardware.
